Backend Engineer - Payments

Responsibilities
- Build and operate payment APIs for high-volume transactions
- Improve latency, reliability, and observability
- Own production services and participate in on-call

Requirements
Skills: Go, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, Kubernetes, REST APIs
Experience: 3+ years backend engineering, payment or fintech experience preferred
Must have: production ownership, CI/CD
Nice to have: observability, Kafka
